name: documents_by_table_and_id
sql: CREATE INDEX documents_by_table_and_id ON documents (table_id, id, ts)

name: documents
sql:
CREATE TABLE documents (
    id BLOB NOT NULL,
    ts INTEGER NOT NULL,

    table_id BLOB NOT NULL,

    json_value TEXT NULL,
    deleted INTEGER NOT NULL,

    prev_ts INTEGER,

    PRIMARY KEY (ts, table_id, id)
)

name: indexes
sql:
CREATE TABLE indexes (
    index_id BLOB NOT NULL,
    ts INTEGER NOT NULL,

    key BLOB NOT NULL,

    deleted INTEGER NOT NULL,

    table_id BLOB NULL,
    document_id BLOB NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (index_id, key, ts)
)

name: persistence_globals
sql:
CREATE TABLE persistence_globals (
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    json_value TEXT NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (key)
)
